**Best move:** Qxf8+

**Main line:** Qxf8+ Kh7 (Kxf8 Rxf7 wins easily) Qg7#

**Motif:** backRankMate (the king is trapped by the pawn on f7 and has no escape squares)

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king looks cramped near the back rank, check for forcing moves like queen captures that give check. Here, Black's king on g8 had nowhere to run—f8 had the queen, f7 was blocked by its own pawn. After Qxf8+, Black must play Kh7, allowing Qg7 mate. Always scan for trapped kings when attacking.
